from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "The Gateway to Linear Algebra: Linear Combinations"
        lines = [
            "Linear combinations involve scaling and adding multiple vectors.",
            "We scale each vector first, then add them together.",
            "This process allows us to reach any point in space.",
            "It is the core concept behind basis vectors and matrices.",
            "These combinations form the foundation of all linear algebra."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)
        
        # Define base vectors
        origin_pos = self.grid["D2"]
        u_color = "#00BFFF"
        v_color = "#FF69B4"
        res_color = "#F0E68C"
        
        u_vec_end = np.array([1, 0.5, 0])
        v_vec_end = np.array([0.5, 1.2, 0])
        
        u_arrow = Arrow(start=origin_pos, end=origin_pos + u_vec_end, color=u_color, buff=0)
        v_arrow = Arrow(start=origin_pos, end=origin_pos + v_vec_end, color=v_color, buff=0)
        
        u_label = MathTex(r"\vec{u}", color=u_color, font_size=24).next_to(u_arrow.get_end(), RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        v_label = MathTex(r"\vec{v}", color=v_color, font_size=24).next_to(v_arrow.get_end(), UP, buff=0.1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display base vectors U #00BFFF and V #FF69B4. Highlight lecture line 1.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(u_color))
        self.play(Create(u_arrow), Write(u_label))
        self.play(Create(v_arrow), Write(v_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Scale Vector U by factor 'a' visually. Highlight lecture line 2.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(u_color)
        )
        
        a_tracker = ValueTracker(1.0)
        
        def get_scaled_u():
            scaled_end = origin_pos + u_vec_end * a_tracker.get_value()
            return Arrow(start=origin_pos, end=scaled_end, color=u_color, buff=0)
        
        def get_u_label():
            val = a_tracker.get_value()
            lbl = MathTex(f"{val:.1f}\\vec{{u}}", color=u_color, font_size=24)
            lbl.next_to(origin_pos + u_vec_end * val, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
            return lbl

        scaled_u = always_redraw(get_scaled_u)
        scaled_u_label = always_redraw(get_u_label)
        
        self.remove(u_arrow, u_label)
        self.add(scaled_u, scaled_u_label)
        
        self.play(a_tracker.animate.set_value(2.5), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Scale Vector V by factor 'b' visually. Highlight lecture line 3.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(v_color)
        )
        
        b_tracker = ValueTracker(1.0)
        
        def get_scaled_v():
            scaled_end = origin_pos + v_vec_end * b_tracker.get_value()
            return Arrow(start=origin_pos, end=scaled_end, color=v_color, buff=0)
        
        def get_v_label():
            val = b_tracker.get_value()
            lbl = MathTex(f"{val:.1f}\\vec{{v}}", color=v_color, font_size=24)
            lbl.next_to(origin_pos + v_vec_end * val, UP, buff=0.1)
            return lbl

        scaled_v = always_redraw(get_scaled_v)
        scaled_v_label = always_redraw(get_v_label)
        
        self.remove(v_arrow, v_label)
        self.add(scaled_v, scaled_v_label)
        
        self.play(b_tracker.animate.set_value(1.8), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Place scaled V at the tip of scaled U. Highlight lecture line 4.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )
        
        # Stop redraws for static-ish move
        u_final_arrow = get_scaled_u()
        v_final_arrow = get_scaled_v()
        u_final_label = get_u_label()
        v_final_label = get_v_label()
        
        self.remove(scaled_u, scaled_u_label, scaled_v, scaled_v_label)
        self.add(u_final_arrow, u_final_label, v_final_arrow, v_final_label)
        
        target_v_start = u_final_arrow.get_end()
        target_v_end = target_v_start + (v_vec_end * b_tracker.get_value())
        
        self.play(
            v_final_arrow.animate.move_to((target_v_start + target_v_end)/2),
            v_final_label.animate.next_to(target_v_end, UP, buff=0.1),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Draw resultant vector 'aU + bV' in #F0E68C. Highlight lecture line 5.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(res_color)
        )
        
        resultant_arrow = Arrow(start=origin_pos, end=target_v_end, color=res_color, buff=0)
        res_label = MathTex(r"a\vec{u} + b\vec{v}", color=res_color, font_size=28)
        res_label.next_to(resultant_arrow.get_center(), DOWN + RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(resultant_arrow), Write(res_label))
        self.wait(3)
